section_summary.extract_value: This section describes one study (unnamed) with a final sample of 288 community-recruited participants in the state of São Paulo, Brazil, including 152 women and 136 men. It reports demographics: mean age (total 24.01 years; women 23.97; men 24.04), self-reported BMI (total 24.17; women 23.29; men 24.96), ethnicity (85.7% white), and education (61.2% undergraduate, 8.0% graduate; combined college or higher = 69.2%).
